case_title: GIL CASTRO, RAUL ANTONIO VS SANCHEZ, MIGUEL et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,048.00 FILED BY GIL CASTRO, RAUL ANTONIO AS TO DEFENDANT SANCHEZ, MIGUEL SANCHEZ, RAUL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-10-2003 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GIL CASTRO, RAUL ANTONIO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SANCHEZ, MIGUEL SANCHEZ, RAUL DFT M. SANCHEZ IS TO OBTAIN SMOG CERTIFICATE FOR VEH HE SOLD TO PLT W/IN 10 DAYS. PLT TO COOPERATE W/ DFT TO ALLOW FOR SMOG TESTING/REPAIR. IF VEH PASSES SMOG W/IN 10 DAYS,THEN THE CONTRACT SHALL BE ENFORCED W/ PLT KEEPING THE VEH &MAKING FURTHER PAYMENTS TO DFT AS CALLED FOR IN THEIR PURCHASE AGREEMENT. (SEE JUDGMENT FOR DETAILS) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
PLTF MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION FILED. $15.40 FEE PAID. SUBMITTED TO COMM FOR ORDER.
SC MOTION DISPOSITION MOTION TO CORRECT JUDGMENT. OF JUN-18-2004, GRANTED
MOTION TO CORRECT JUDGMENT. FILED BY PLAINTIFF GIL CASTRO, RAUL ANTONIO HEARING SET FOR JUN-18-2004 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING AMENDED JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GIL CASTRO, RAUL ANTONIO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SANCHEZ, MIGUEL SANCHEZ, RAUL $3,048.00 PRINCIPAL, $22.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,070.00, PLFT'S MOTION TO CORRECT JUDGMENT OF 11/10/03 IS GRANTED. DEFT FAILED TO SATISFY THE JUDGMENT WHICH ALLOWED DEFT 10 DAYS TO OBTAIN SMOG CERTIFICATE. THE JUDGMENT IS AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE SPECIFIC DOLLAR AMT PRAYED FOR BY PLFT IN THE AMT OF $3048. PLFT'S REQUEST THAT AGREEMENT BE VOIDED IS GRANTED PLFT TO RETURN CAR TO DEFT. DEFT TO PAY PLFT $3048 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
